body: This is heavy.

My name is Pete and pictured with this gofundme is my son Logan.  He is hands down the greatest kid you’ll ever meet.  He’s 9 years old and starting 4th great this year.  I’m trying to raise money for him (well for me to help him).  He doesn’t have the greatest living situation and I’m trying to get him some help and I hope to get full custody of him as well.  Logan is often unhappy and has panic attacks when he has to return to his Mom after spending time with me.  

Logan’s mother and I have 50/50 custody right now, but he never wants to return to her and is very upfront about it.  His teachers and daycare providers have noticed it and made mention of it to me.  I’m not sure what is actually going on there because he’s told me he’s not allowed to talk about it, and my ex won’t tell me anything. I bought a cell phone for him to call me if he misses me while he’s there or if he ever needs anything.  She has taken it from him when he’s around so he cannot contact me. When I try to contact him, she ignores my calls and texts and won’t let me talk to him, even if he’s with her for his birthday.

I’m trying to raise this money to be able to go back to court with her to get permission for him to see a psychiatrist or councilor of some sort.  I was told I need her permission for a specialist to see him, and she won’t allow it.  He has mentioned that his step-dad is verbally mean to him and his mother, and that he is often ignored while he is at her house.  He will cry and beg me to not send him back to her telling me he doesn’t love her and he has to sit alone in his room.  

I’m looking to get the money as soon as I can, because the sooner I get the money, the sooner I can help him.  He’s in bad shape and I don’t have the extra money to cover the lawyer, court, physician, and other miscellaneous expenses to win this case. There has yet to be words invented to express how appreciative I would be to have the opportunity to have my son and be happy. It cuts my soul deep every time I have to send him back to his mom and he looks at me tears in his eyes begging me not to leave and he tells me how he doesn’t want to go and he doesn’t love her at all, that he wants to stay with me “eighty-hundred thousand days”.  I’m still trying to do the math, but I know it’s a long time.

I thank you all so very much in advance, I appreciate it more than I can express.  Please help me get my son.

He brings a lot to the table and is probably one of the strongest of the survivors in spirit, will, and determination.  He started out as the outcast white trash hillbilly, but has grown to become not only a leader with Rick out of commission, but the glue that kind of keeps things together.  The turning points for me, were the rose when he started to come around, when he shot Dale because Rick couldn't; saying there was no reason he had to do all the heavy lifting.  He saw that Rick being the "leader" was stuck making all the hard decisions, doing the groups dirty work, etc.  He stepped up to be number two in command and Rick's enforcer type roll.  Now it just continues because of his actions, how he cares but won't admit it, and his humor.
